## Description

Buy and sell options at different expirations (and sometimes strikes) to express views on term structure, decay or direction.

## Where it may fit

Relative-value opportunities in implied-volatility term structure and stable near-term price behavior.

## Vehicles

Volatility-arbitrage and options market-neutral portfolios.

## Required data

Multi-expiration option chains, implied-volatility surface, Greeks, dividends, rates and assignment risk.

## Caveats

Position risk changes nonlinearly with price, time and volatility; mark-to-market assumptions are critical.
